note: Real run on a live site and DataForSEO account, anonymised: brand, domain, pages, queries, competitors and ids replaced; numbers rounded to 2 significant figures, so totals may not add up exactly.
how_it_was_made: Real run on 2026-10-02 through the InsightfulPipe CLI (same calls as the MCP), on a live site and a DataForSEO account. Generated by make_sample.py from the raw responses; no numbers typed by hand. Every keyword is shown as query-N with its theme: the platform it names (lettered) or the topic word, plus its form where it has one (long form, abbreviation, other form, word order swapped, with the assistant name, with best). The same keyword keeps the same label in both files.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "keyword-research-clustering" skill. Research keywords for "<the site's product category>", cluster them, and tell me which pages to build first for example.com.
products_offered: the product pages under /integrations/ in the site's sitemap

product_aliases_confirmed.platform B, name 1: platform B, name 2, which its product page slug uses

data_pulled: labs_keyword_suggestions once per seed, x4, limit 200 (300 rows)
labs_related_keywords on the main seed "query-1 (platform A)" (14 rows)
labs_keyword_ideas not run: suggestions and related returned 310 rows, so the list was not thin
labs_keyword_overview and labs_search_intent on the 37-keyword shortlist (the build-time calls covered 40 keywords; the 3 that only rows past 200 found are not used)
serp_google_organic for "query-9 (platform B, name 1)" and "query-12 (platform B, name 2)"

kw_google_trends_explore past_12_months for the 5 top-ranked cluster heads (query-9 (platform B, name 1), query-20 (platform C), query-1 (platform A), query-26 (platform D), query-37 (platform E, other form, long form))
search_analytics by query and page (2300 rows)
sitemaps_list (Search Console), then the sitemap it names (https://example.com/sitemap.xml, 320 URLs, among them the product pages under /integrations/)
limit_note: SKILL.md sets limit 200. The "query-4 (seed, broadest term)" suggestions call was run with limit 500 while the skill was being built; this sample uses its first 200 rows, which is what a limit-200 call sorted by volume returns. Rows 169 to 202 of that call all have 170 searches a month, so a real limit-200 call could leave out a different 2 of those 34 tied rows; "query-21 (platform C, long form)" is the only shortlisted keyword among them, and it also comes from the "query-3 (seed, generic term 2)" suggestions call. Of the build-time shortlist, the keywords that only rows past 200 found are handled as SKILL.md step 2 says: "query-27 (platform D, long form)" and "query-36 (platform G, long form)" are Search Console queries, so they come in from there; "query-32 (platform L, long form)", "query-33 (platform M, long form)" and "query-38 (platform N, long form)" have no other source, so they are left out.
